tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The brand's ink: logo, headlines, body text and primary buttons on light grounds; the background of dark bands.

tokens.name: brand-harbor
tokens.usage: Links, italic emphasis and numbering on white or Paper (6.2:1 on white). On Navy use link-on-dark instead.

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: The gold core of the mark, square points and primary buttons on Navy. Never as text on white (1.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Warm alternate section background on light pages.

tokens.name: brand-pulse
tokens.usage: Intensive Care marker and form errors, as a shape only, never body text (3.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: Evidence notes and progress tracks.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white (6.9:1) and Paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and emphasis on surface (Harbor on light; a lighter Harbor tint on Navy for 4.5:1+).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The full-strength 1px rule that opens a section.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every year a school struggles is a year children don't get back.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph of a page.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.usage: The italic accent word in a headline, in link (Harbor) or Signal on Navy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We diagnose honestly, treat urgently, and stay until the results hold.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and navigation, set in capitals.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small tracked labels, set in capitals. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related small items; the gap between blocks of the mark scales from this.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups and columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large layout gaps.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner. The brand is square: buttons, cards, fields, images and the blocks of the mark.
